title: QGIS, external sources, integration
architecture_candidate: Keep PyQGIS and desktop connector adapters; migrate backend routes and SSRF/provider transport to Rust.

auth_and_tenant_boundaries.provider_transport_guard: Public IPv4 SSRF blocklist, bounded byte/range fetch, strong ETag check.
auth_and_tenant_boundaries.qgis_connector_auth: Browser OIDC pairing or scoped Bearer token; secret redaction in logs/errors.

external_provider_transport.security_boundary: Public IPv4 SSRF guard, bounded deadline/size, strong ETag verification for range/byte fetches.

metadata.name: OpenVietGIS Connector
metadata.description: Connect QGIS to OpenVietGIS maps, edit layers and save safely to Web; GeoPackage recovery under Advanced.
metadata.about: OpenVietGIS QGIS Connector 1.0. Project-scoped HTTPS service credentials, explicit project.read for session and export, project.edit plus GIS ACL for writes. Local baseline comparison and server-managed realtime with durable changesets. Denied sync never deletes local edits. No internal PostGIS credentials.
metadata.author: OpenVietGIS
